title: Methods defaults and reporting conventions
text: Logistic models report odds ratios. CIs exponentiated log-odds scale. SE style, SEs delta-method SEs. Pairwise contrasts compare estimated marginal means, averaged predictors, using covariance matrix coefficients. contrast_adjust adjusts p-values CIs within factor. across-outcome correction (dv_adjust) treats row one family across outcomes, widens rows’ CIs match (Bonferroni across outcomes, top within-factor adjustment). Text output prints CI’s real level, example “98.3% CI” Holm-adjusted contrast among three conditions. three “Gain” p-values three outcomes corrected together. corrections , contrasts adjusted within factor first across outcomes, conservative. cr_tidy() keeps p.within final p.value. Fit block: N, random-effect variances, adjusted ICC, Nakagawa marginal conditional R² random-intercept models, R² (lm), Tjur R² (logit), AIC. Missing data: model uses complete cases variables. N reported per model.

title: Methods defaults and reporting conventions
text: d, g, d_z (CIs) simple-test helpers match effectsize package. adjust , CIs (including d’s) Bonferroni-adjusted match corrected p-values, CI excludes zero always comes significant adjusted p. Model-based d (cr_d(res), cr_table(res, effect_size = TRUE)) divides pooled within-group SD outcome linear models, covariates don’t inflate . mixed models divides total SD one observation: residual variance plus variance random effects add, random slopes included.
